_comment: issue #12 regression sample: `Assigned To` is functional (an Agent Node is assigned to at most one Team Node), declared WITHOUT `distinctIndividuals`. Under pure OWL open-world semantics two distinct targets are merely entailed EQUAL (no inconsistency), so the real engine used to silently pass. The closed-world functional check must flag it identically to the deterministic engine (SHACL sh:maxCount 1).
